To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the responses of forest cover to the monsoon change in northern China are variable and the changes in forest cover are not always synchronous with the monsoon development; (ii) the responses of vegetation cover and type to the monsoon are different; (iii) the forest at its marginal distribution is more sensitive to drought than at its center.

(1) the forest at the limit of monsoon influence responded to the monsoon change in the past 86000a, (2) the forest at this location had variable responses to the monsoon drying, (3) the responses of the forest to drought were different from those of vegetation type and tree cover.

the responses of forest to the monsoon change at its distribution limit and provides new insights into the forest dynamics in semi-arid regions, especially in the context of climate change.
the relationship between forest and the monsoon, which is of significance for understanding forest dynamics in semi-arid areas.
the response of forest to climate change in the northern China, which is important for understanding the dynamics of forest in the marginal regions of the Asian monsoon.
